plugins.guideTitle: How to build and import a plugin
plugins.guideDevelopBody: Create a folder with plugin.yaml and an entry Python file (for example main.py). plugin.yaml needs id, version, name, kind (tool / skill / hook), and entry. In setup(ctx): tool → ctx.tool(...); skill → ctx.skills("skills"); hook → ctx.middleware(...). See the repo plugins/ demos for each kind.
plugins.guidePackageBody: Zip the plugin so the archive contains exactly one plugin root with plugin.yaml inside it (either at the zip root or in a single top-level folder). Example: zip -r my-plugin.zip my-plugin/
plugins.guideImportBody: Host the .zip where MAITU Smart Manufacturing can download it over HTTP(S). Prefer a raw file URL. Configure each agent from Personalization → Plugins. Local demos: maitu plugin install ./plugins/demo-toolkit --force
